title: Pairing link parameters
description: The parameters of a pairing link (PROTOCOL.md §3), as built by `buildUploadLink`: the query string of `pulsecam://?…`, or the fragment of `https://mieweb.github.io/pulse/open#…`, encoded as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` in UTF-8. Clients must ignore parameters they don't recognize. Lengths are in characters: Unicode code points.

v.description: Link format version. A client refuses a link whose `v` it doesn't know.

artifactId.description: The artifact the pairing is for: the video's id. Related artifacts declare it as `relatedTo`.

server.description: Base URL of the server, including its path prefix (e.g. `https://vault.example.org/pulsevault`). The client builds every request as `${server}/<path>`.

token.description: Optional credential the client sends as `Authorization: Bearer`, unchanged. Typically a capability token (capability-token.schema.json), from which a client may read `exp` and `ref` (§5.6).

label.description: Optional (protocol 2.7, §3.1): what the client calls the place this upload goes to, e.g. a ticket's title. An unsigned display hint, like `name`, `app` and `return`: it acts only on a link whose `token` carries a `ref` claim, the place's key, and is ignored on any other link.

name.description: Optional (protocol 2.7): what the client names a new recording made for the place, e.g. "Huddle update". Absent: the recording starts unnamed. Unsigned; ignored unless `token` carries a `ref`.

app.description: Optional (protocol 2.7): the host app's name, shown with `label`. Unsigned; ignored unless `token` carries a `ref`.

return.description: Optional (protocol 2.7): a page in the host to go back to after the upload. `https://`, or `http://` to localhost or a private IP for development, with no username or password. Unsigned; ignored unless `token` carries a `ref`.
